engineering.heading: Engineering
engineering.intro: I tend to build systems around a few principles.
engineering.principle.explicit-state.des: Important state should be inspectable rather than implicit.
engineering.principle.determinism.title: Determinism
engineering.principle.determinism.desc: The same inputs should produce the same result whenever practical.
engineering.principle.fail-closed.title: Fail closed
engineering.principle.fail-closed.desc: Incomplete evidence should not silently become confidence.
engineering.principle.reproducibility.de: A claim should be measurable and rerunnable.
engineering.principle.separation.title: Separation of concerns
engineering.principle.separation.desc: Format-specific behavior belongs at the boundary; generic machinery belongs in the core.
engineering.principle.evidence.title: Show evidence
engineering.principle.evidence.desc: Claims without measurements are marketing. Show the data.
